purpose: Bounded hard-surface reference-to-model generalization test; not an I0 promotion.
observations: The head is bilaterally symmetric in the front view and can be built as one connected low-poly cage mirrored across X.
Its outer contour has two broad upper blades, concave waists, lower points and a narrow central socket.
The long shaft is one continuous 12-16 sided form with controlled radial changes for collars rather than many stacked cylinders.
Metal collars are justified separate fitted assemblies; the leather wrap is deferred until major-form approval.
The reference supplies only a front view, so depth must remain a conservative reversible hypothesis.

construction.head: Start from one box/cage, mirror, add only contour-defining loops, extrude thickness, use crease-weighted SubD and a small live bevel only where highlight width requires it.
construction.shaft: One 12-sided connected radial cage with loop-scaled collar transitions; preserve a circular cross-section with minimal topology.
construction.assemblies: Separate only the fitted head socket/collars and the optional leather wrap because they are physically distinct parts.

bounded_cutoff: One blockout and one silhouette correction. No sculpting, damage, grain, leather detail, UVs or materials before an 8/10 major-form score.
success_gate: Front silhouette, head-to-shaft proportion, concave blade contour, collar placement and plausible 3/4 depth must reach 8/10.
